_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P1 operational targets.

requirements.description: Deterministic wireframe rendering of any spec page with claim annotations, side-by-side variant compare with promote-to-spec, and an optional AI-image render mode composing image-tools.
requirements.title: Render and workshop

validation.notes: Proves deterministic page-to-wireframe rendering is byte-stable and includes claim annotations.
Proves stable side-by-side variant rendering artifacts.
Promotes a selected variant through parser-clean apply semantics.
Pins optional image mode degradation when image-tools is unavailable.

requirements.description: Derive `bas/cases` stubs from spec entries (routes to navigation, claims to assertions, bindings to selectors) for workflow-health governance, with spec-to-case reference-integrity findings in both directions.
requirements.title: BAS case scaffolding

validation.notes: Derives BAS case stubs and registry entries from active page specs with spec_entry_id linkage and idempotent apply.
Proves the native ScaffoldCases RPC uses the deterministic case-scaffold fixer path for dry-run and apply.

requirements.description: Preview and apply mechanical fixes for binding drift, index normalization, missing state stubs, and finding-doc stubs with accounting of fixed versus remaining findings.
requirements.title: Deterministic autofix

validation.notes: Checks preview/apply accounting and idempotency for deterministic sequential fix application.
Covers deterministic binding drift placeholder repair.
Proves shared PreviewFix and ApplyFix RPCs use the live registry.

requirements.description: Manual-tier claims are attested with an expiry; expired attestations surface as findings so human-verified experience promises decay honestly instead of staying green forever.
requirements.title: Manual attestation ledger

validation.notes: Expired manual-tier attestations emit experience.attestation_expired findings.
AST guard proves the SQLite ledger has exactly one write seam: AppendAttestation.

requirements.description: Compute-on-read sweep of spec coverage and depth across all scenarios, scored worst-first so experience debt is visible and prioritized fleet-wide.
requirements.title: Fleet sweep

validation.notes: Proves compute-on-read fleet sweep includes scenarios without experience specs and sorts debt worst-first.
